notes.title: Demo 2.4
notes.content:
Demo 2.4 is available. Just minor tweaks and polish. We are working on some quality of life things for the future like a quick look at what upgrades you have and a dummy to shoot in the upgrade hall. 

Tweaks
adjusted the ceilings for some levels
adjusted the collision for the explosive barrels so bullets hit it properly
made the arrows for the arrowfall card bigger
added more arrows for the arrowfall card
adjusted the stats of the arrows for the arrowfall card and its upgrades

notes.title: Demo 2.3
notes.content:
A new demo build is out with more tweaks and fixes.

Fixes for the weapon system
Fixes for the dodge ability
Added an action lock that restricts or stops certain actions while dodging or switching weapons
Removed the music playing in the main menu
Added the missing gamepad input binding for steam overlay

notes.title: Demo v2
notes.content:
A new version of our demo is out with a good chunk of bug fixes. Again, thank you all for playing and giving our game a look.

Bug Fixes
Fixed the save system bug preventing a new save file
Fixed the mission fail state that resets the player
Fixed the xp requirement bug that kept the amount needed to level up the same, despite losing the points
Fixed the weapon upgrade bugs preventing some weapons from being upgraded
Overhauled the enemy spawn system to minimize enemy spawning in difficult to navigate spaces
Fixed  volume of the defend AI landing sound effects
Fixed the defend AI health bar so its visuals are more clear
Removed the large outdoor map due to various issues
Added the defend variation of the cave map
Move the collisions for the barrels upwards more so they don't block the player and bullets
Small changes to a few maps
